issues.legal_issue: State legislatures have exclusive authority under Entry 3 of List II to prescribe court-fee rules, and Entry 11A of List III does not govern court-fee refunds merely because a dispute was settled through alternative dispute resolution.

The reference in the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 to the Court Fees Act, 1870 for refunds following a Lok Adalat award does not extend the same refund entitlement to disputes settled through mediation under Section 89 of the Code of Civil Procedure.

The Maharashtra Court Fees Act, 1959 governed court-fee refunds for disputes settled through mediation before the 2018 amendment, and the appellant was not entitled under the central legislation to a complete refund as a matter of law.
A complete refund of court fees may be granted under Article 142 of the Constitution in the exceptional circumstances of the case without creating a binding precedent.
